response.overview: 🎬 The Last Login (2026)  Tagline: “Every Secret Has a Price. Everyone logged in… but will anyone be able to log out?”  Plot: Four close friends—Ankit, Khush, Vipul, and Abhishek—find their friendship shattered by betrayal and a tragic incident that leads to Abhishek’s death. Soon, the surviving trio becomes trapped inside an abandoned bungalow where the main exit mysteriously locks from within. Haunted by Abhishek’s vengeful spirit, they face a terrifying game involving mysterious UNO cards, including deadly +4 cards, that impose sinister rules. As paranoia grows and dark secrets emerge, trust turns into fear. Meanwhile, IPS officer Aditya investigates the mysterious property, uncovering a hidden key that may reveal the horrifying truth behind the haunting.  Characters: Ankit, Khush, and Vipul are the surviving friends; Abhishek returns as a vengeful spirit; Officer Aditya investigates the mystery and searches for the truth.
